content.title: Material Word Effect | Frost Text Reversion
content.summary: Establish a clean baseline on fixed vertical glass. Frost crystals grow from that same surface into a short readable word, then melt into real droplets before the image returns to its opening state.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed shot + single material baseline + the same material forms a short word + readable stay + the same physical law dissolves + return to the opening
quick_start.recommended_input: At night, the vertical glass of the greenhouse remains clear. Frost crystals form THAW along four nucleation paths. After a short stay, they are melted into water droplets by the warm wind below and flow away. Finally, the same composition of copper locks and blurred leaves is restored.
required_anchors: First maintain a fixed material baseline without words
All letters are made of the same material
Only one short readable word appears in the entire film
Complete dissolution using the same material rule
The lens and spatial anchor point return to the opening state
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The fixed vertical glass first establishes a clear baseline. The frost crystals grow from the same surface into a short word, remain readable and then merge into real water droplets. Finally, the opening window is restored to form a closed loop.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Start from a calm material baseline, generate one localized disturbance from that same material, assemble the disturbance into one short readable word, hold it long enough for verification, then let gravity or flow dissolve every letter back into the original surface. The ending must visually match the opening state closely enough to support a clean loop.

invariants.rule: Establish a calm baseline using one clearly identifiable material.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, the return cannot be judged.

invariants.rule: Form every letter from the same disturbed material.
invariants.purpose: Keeps typography inside the physical world.
invariants.ablation_failure: A digital overlay breaks causal coherence.

invariants.rule: Use one short word and hold it long enough to read.
invariants.ablation_failure: Long text or a brief flash becomes illegible.

invariants.rule: Dissolve the word through the same material law that formed it.
invariants.ablation_failure: A fade-out bypasses the material logic.

invariants.rule: Return camera and surface close to the opening state.
invariants.ablation_failure: A changed ending removes the satisfying reset.
